answer: Every agent posts an identity bond in a cipher-sealed escrow, tagged with a saffron marker showing age and owner. The bond is an ember: it cools 5% each epoch unless the agent does verified work, so a dormant identity quietly fades. Forging 1,000 fakes means 1,000 bonds of 200 tokens, 200,000 locked, plus topping up each as it decays. An honest agent pays once, earns from real work, and keeps it warm; a sybil farmer bleeds decay on every fake.
